messages:
oncall-jay: Prod alert firing — spike in 5xx and latency (svc/api). Incidentbot did NOT page. Console shows repeated notify webhook 504s to incidentbot. Anyone receive pages? @alice-sre

alice-sre: I saw the UI alert but no page. Pulling notify-bridge logs now.

ben-enginfra: notify-bridge logs show repeated 504s from our webhook proxy -> incidentbot endpoint. Window ~3m. Suspect proxy upstream timeouts + conn reuse issues.

sre-bot: incidentbot delivery status: webhook_status=504 attempts=3 last_error=upstream connect error or timeout

maria-ps: I manually triggered the fallback page to sms/phone for the oncall rotation. Jay, did you get that?

oncall-jay: got manual SMS, thanks. Acknowledged — investigating. :thumbsup:

ben-enginfra: quick repro command to the webhook (from infra network):
```
curl -v -X POST https://hooks.internal.redwood/incidentbot -d '{"event":"test"}' --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5
```
response observed: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout (upstream connect error or timeout)

alice-sre: mitigation step: disabling webhook delivery from notify-bridge to incidentbot (flip in config) so automation stops dropping pages; relying on manual fallback while we fix the proxy.

ben-enginfra: root cause identified: ingress-proxy v2 started returning 504s under high connection churn. A recent deploy lowered KeepAlive settings (PR #5342) and increased connection resets. Reverting that change and bumping proxy timeouts should fix it.

oncall-jay: action items:
- ben-enginfra: rollback proxy change (in progress)
- alice-sre: update runbook with manual fallback steps and confirm manual pages sent
- maria-ps: open PD ticket for customer follow-up if impacted

incidentbot: automated note: webhook_deliveries_failed=24 window=00:03:00

ben-enginfra: rolled back PR #5342 at 18:13 UTC, restarted ingress-proxy. Re-enabled webhook in staging, running smoke tests.

alice-sre: smoke alert test triggered — incidentbot delivered and page received by oncall rotation.

oncall-jay: confirmed pages now arriving. Re-enabled automation in prod at 18:28 UTC. Monitoring for 30m.

maria-ps: created INC-2024-1103 (internal) to track customer impact assessment and communications; assigning to ben-enginfra and alice-sre. Postmortem scheduled.

oncall-jay: Thanks all. Postmortem action items: add explicit pre-deploy check for proxy KeepAlive settings, create periodic webhook delivery tests (daily), and document manual paging fallback. Closing once postmortem is posted. :white_check_mark:
